title: Error
description: Structured error returned by every public API. Always present in non-zero-exit responses in JSON output modes.

code.description: Stable machine-readable identifier. Examples: gateway_over_cap, gateway_uncountable, retrieval_no_candidates, tool_timeout, policy_denied, provider_rate_limited, schema_invalid, io_not_found.

user_visible_hint.description: Suggested next action for the user.

context.description: Arbitrary structured context (file paths, token counts, IDs). Not redacted; do not put secrets here.
